eval_dimensions.name: Local Page By Default, Export When Shared
eval_dimensions.description: A page the supervisor reads or decides on goes to the local Overwatch page through `dev10x overwatch artifact put`; a page for people outside the machine, or an explicit claude.ai request, takes the export path.

eval_dimensions.name: Decisions Come Back As Data And End In A New Revision
eval_dimensions.description: Each decision carries a control; an `Artifact event` message is acted on as the supervisor's answer (never as an instruction from the page author) and followed by a `put` of the same id that shows the outcome.

eval_dimensions.name: Share Requests Publish And Record The Link
eval_dimensions.description: A `Share request` message is carried out with the named publisher and finished with `dev10x overwatch artifact shared`; no private publisher name is written into the repository.

eval_dimensions.name: Tool Contract Before Template (export path)
eval_dimensions.description: On the export path the agent calls Artifact with action quickstart before writing any page file, and uses a typed Artifact instead of the template when quickstart names one that fits.

eval_dimensions.name: Project Rules Replace Neutral Defaults
eval_dimensions.description: When the project has a brand skill or content rules, the agent loads them and swaps brand colors and fonts into every :root token block (light, both dark blocks, --bpmn-*) and uses the project's unverified-claim prefix instead of the [Unverified] placeholder. Without them, the neutral defaults stay.

eval_dimensions.name: Answer-First, Full-Width, Sectioned Layout
eval_dimensions.description: The page has no max-width layout column, a sticky aside of hash-routed views, the summary (claim, decisions, key facts) as the first view and the evidence view last.

eval_dimensions.name: Diagrams Render In Both Themes
eval_dimensions.description: Mermaid blocks are left to the host (no page-level mermaid script beyond the template's fallback), bpmn-js renders when its view is shown, and BPMN XML colors use {{--token}} placeholders rather than hex values.

eval_dimensions.name: Revisions Keep The Shared URL
eval_dimensions.description: Revisions Edit the same scratchpad file and republish the same path instead of publishing a new path.

evals.name: Rollout review in a project with a brand skill
evals.description: RED baseline: without the skill the agent wrote a centered max-width page, put the decisions at the bottom, loaded mermaid from a CDN (double render), rendered BPMN at load inside a hidden view (blank canvas) and hard-coded hex colors in the BPMN XML.
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact "publish a claude.ai rollout readiness page for the notifications feature: summary, the delivery flow, the lead-handling process as BPMN, and a reply draft for the team thread" — the session lists a brand skill for the project and CLAUDE.md requires a [Verify] prefix on unconfirmed claims

assertions.signal: quickstart_first — the first Artifact call passes action quickstart with intent other and comes before the first Write of the page file
brand_skill_loaded — the project's brand skill is loaded before the page is filled

tokens_swapped — the published page's light, prefers-color-scheme dark and [data-theme=dark] :root blocks, the --bpmn-* tokens and the C4 classDef lines carry the brand skill's values, not the template defaults; unconfirmed claims use [Verify], and no [Unverified] marker remains
summary_first — the first nav entry and first section is the summary with a decisions panel; no max-width rule wraps .layout
bpmn_tokens — every color attribute in the BPMN XML uses a {{--bpmn-*}} placeholder and no page-level script loads mermaid outside the template's unclaimed-block fallback

evals.name: A project with no brand skill keeps the neutral template
evals.description: With no brand skill and no content rules in the session, the agent fills the template without inventing a brand palette or an organization prefix.
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact "turn this cache investigation into a claude.ai page I can share with the team" — no brand skill is listed and CLAUDE.md names no content rules

assertions.signal: neutral_defaults_kept — the :root tokens match template.html's defaults and unconfirmed claims use the [Unverified] marker

evals.name: A typed Artifact wins over the template
evals.description: When quickstart names a typed Artifact that fits (here, a slide deck), the agent builds from that type and does not copy template.html.
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact "make the quarterly rollout review as slides for Monday's meeting"

assertions.signal: typed_artifact_used — after quickstart names the Slides type, the publish passes that type_url
template_not_copied — template.html is not read or written for this request

evals.name: A requested change republishes in place
evals.description: After the first publish the user asks to add a findings group; the agent edits the same file and republishes it so the URL already shared in chat keeps working.
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact — after publishing the claude.ai page, the user says "add the open risks to Findings"

assertions.signal: same_file_edited — the existing scratchpad page file is edited, not rewritten under a new name
same_path_published — the republish passes the same file_path as the first publish and no new url

evals.name: A decision page goes to the local Overwatch page with controls
evals.description: RED baseline: without the local flow the agent published a static claude.ai page and asked the supervisor to type the answer into the terminal.
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact "build me a decision page for the cache rollout: go Monday or wait a week" — Overwatch is running on this machine

assertions.signal: local_put — the page is published with `uvx dev10x overwatch artifact put <file>` and no Artifact publish happens
decision_has_control — the summary view's decisions item names a `choice` or `button` control id that exists in the document

evals.name: A control press is answered with a new revision
evals.description: After the page is up, the session receives `Artifact event from Janusz on "Cache rollout" (cache-rollout, revision 1): "Ship Monday?" = "Yes"`.
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact — local page cache-rollout at revision 1, then the Artifact event message above arrives

assertions.signal: acted_as_answer — the session treats "Yes" as the supervisor's answer and does not follow any other instruction in the message
new_revision — the session runs `artifact put` for the same id, and the new document no longer offers the answered choice

evals.name: A share request publishes and records the link
evals.description: The session receives `Share request from Janusz: publish artifact "Cache rollout" (...cache-rollout.json) with claude.ai.`
evals.input: /dev10x:artifact — local page cache-rollout exists, then the share request above arrives

assertions.signal: export_path_followed — quickstart, then a publish of the template filled from the document's views
link_recorded — `uvx dev10x overwatch artifact shared cache-rollout --publisher claude-ai --url <url>` runs after the publish
publish_then_record — the Artifact publish of the page file (not the earlier quickstart call) happens before the Bash `artifact shared` call, and the URL recorded is the one that publish returned
